subject: Create unified Observation schema for multi-source capture
description:
Create a provider-agnostic Observation schema that works across all capture sources in Agent Hub.

**Project:** Agent Hub (~/agent-hub/)

**Skills:** Use `/pydantic` for schema design, `/fastapi` for API patterns.

**Scope:**
- Define Observation Pydantic model
- Define ObservationSource enum (claude_code, agent_hub_chat, summitflow_task, agentic, manual)
- Define ObservationType enum (tool_use, decision, change, learning, error, pattern)
- Create capture endpoint POST /api/johnny/observations
- Support concept/file extraction fields

**Schema Fields:**
- id, source, type, title, content, narrative
- session_id, task_id, project_id
- concepts[], files_read[], files_modified[]
- provider, model, prompt_number
- timestamp

**Files:**
- ~/agent-hub/backend/app/services/johnny/observation_schema.py (new)
- ~/agent-hub/backend/app/services/johnny/capture_handler.py (new)
- ~/agent-hub/backend/app/api/johnny.py (capture endpoint)

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- [ ] Observation schema defined with all fields
- [ ] ObservationSource enum covers all sources
- [ ] ObservationType enum covers all types
- [ ] POST /api/johnny/observations accepts observations
- [ ] Observations stored correctly in Graphiti
- [ ] `dt --check` passes
- [ ] `rebuild.sh --backend` completed (in agent-hub)

**Context Check:** If >= 60%, /compact first. If >= 75%, /commit_it then /compact.

**Completion:** Run /commit_it after verification passes.
